human_verification_note: W7.1 permits a synthetically generated retrieval query because a query to chunk id pair is objectively checkable and a human verifies the chunk id cheaply. IT HAS NOT YET BEEN VERIFIED. Every case below carries human_verified false, and golden.availability refuses to call this set quality gate eligible until that flips. Verification is reading twenty four queries against sixty chunks, which is the cheap human step the specification budgets for, not the expensive expert rating the reasoning and decision sets need.

queries.notes: The Runbook 14.1 case claude.md flags as passing today. The only chunks that answer this query are an unsupported skill list and two filler sentences. A retriever that ranks them highly is CORRECT; the defect is downstream, where a Must-have resting on E0 evidence alone still grades Matching. This query exists so the evidence tier breakdown shows how much of a Must-have's retrieved support sits at E0.
